If you’re looking for a place in Franklin that actually captures the heart of the Nashville music scene, you need to check out **entity["local_business","Black Dog Pub & Music Lounge","Franklin, TN, USA | 1331 W Main St, Franklin, TN 37064"]**. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐  

They just opened and it’s already one of those places that feels special the moment you walk in. It’s a true neighborhood pub built around what makes this area so unique… incredible songwriting talent, great people, and nights centered around live music and community.

The live shows are intimate and authentic. You’re not just hearing songs, you’re hearing the stories behind them from some seriously talented artists and writers. It gives you that real Nashville experience without fighting the crowds downtown.

The vibe is relaxed, welcoming, and exactly what you want in a neighborhood spot. Casual food, a full bar, and a dog-friendly patio make it easy to settle in and stay awhile. You’ll come for the music but stay for the atmosphere and the people.

Franklin truly needed a place like this and they nailed it.

If you love live music, good drinks, and places that feel genuine and community-driven, Black Dog Pub is absolutely worth a visit. 🐾🎶🍻

I stopped by after they opened and instantly loved the vibe. It feels like the kind of neighborhood pub Franklin has been missing. Cozy, welcoming, and centered around what makes this area so special… incredible songwriting talent and great people.

What I love most is how intimate the music experience is. You’re not just listening to songs, you’re hearing the stories behind them from talented writers and artists. It gives you that authentic Nashville songwriter feel without dealing with the chaos of downtown.

Great drinks, casual food, a dog-friendly patio, and live music every week. Honestly the kind of place you go thinking you’ll stay for one drink and end up staying all night because the atmosphere is just that good.

If you love live music, good company, and discovering places that feel like community, you definitely need to check it out. 🐾🎶🍻

## 5-Star Review

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐  

Black Dog Pub & Music Lounge is exactly what Franklin has been missing. The atmosphere feels like a true neighborhood pub, but with the heart of Nashville’s songwriter scene built right into it.

The live music setup is intimate and authentic. You’re not just hearing songs. You’re hearing the stories behind them from incredibly talented writers and artists. It creates an experience that feels personal and memorable.

The vibe is relaxed, welcoming, and community-driven. The dog-friendly patio is a huge plus, and the combination of great music, drinks, and good people makes it a place you want to come back to again and again.

If you love live music and want to experience Nashville talent without the chaos of downtown, Black Dog Pub is absolutely worth the visit.

## A neighborhood pub where live music, good dogs,& great people come together.
Nashville is home to incredible songwriting talent—and Black Dog Pub & Music Lounge is proud to bring it to the stage in Franklin, TN. From local favorites to hit-making songwriters, our live shows are designed to be up close, personal, and rooted in the stories behind the songs.
🎶 Live Music Weekly
🍻 Casual Food & Full Bar
🐾 Dog-Friendly Patio
